title: Waku Waku Puyo Puyo Dungeon (Demo)
native_title: わくわくぷよぷよダンジョン
overview:
A Thrilling Grand Adventure Set in a Mysterious Theme Park!

- Three very distinctive protagonists to choose from!
- A relaxed, easygoing RPG you can play casually
- Attractions that change shape every time you enter!

不思議なテーマパークを舞台に繰り広げられるスリル満点の大冒険！

選べる主人公はとっても個性的な3人！
気軽に遊べるお気楽お手軽なRPG
入るたびに形の変わるアトラクション！
